finding.claim: wipe() calls requireRole(), which only returns a boolean and never throws, and discards the result. The OWNER check is never enforced, so any authenticated user can wipe any tenant's data. export() correctly uses checkRole(), which throws, so the two endpoints are inconsistent.
finding.source: Any authenticated caller of POST /tenants/{t}/wipe. They need no OWNER role and choose the tenant path parameter.
finding.sink: repo.wipe(tenant), a destructive operation that deletes all data for the tenant.

trace.note: wipe(User u, String tenant) is the handler entry point; the tenant comes from the request path
requireRole(u, "OWNER") returns false for a non-owner, and the return value is ignored
requireRole only returns u.roles().contains(role). It has no throw path, as its Javadoc says.

finding.guards_checked: The only guard on the path is requireRole at line 26, and it has no effect. There is no other authorization in wipe(). The user's roles are never checked against the tenant. checkRole (line 18) would enforce the check but is not used here.
